architecture_decisions.recommendation: Removed poetry.toml file and updated uv.lock to use stable versions instead of release candidates
architecture_decisions.rationale: The repository is transitioning from Poetry to uv for dependency management. Removing poetry.toml eliminates configuration conflicts and ensures uv is the sole package manager. Changing version constraints from rc (release candidate) to stable versions (e.g., 0.3.34rc2 → 0.3.34) indicates the release is ready for production use and no longer in pre-release testing phase.
alternatives_considered: Keeping both package managers with sync logic
Maintaining rc versions for additional testing

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Added UV_NO_SYNC=true environment variable to all GitHub Actions workflows and changed uv sync commands to use --inexact flag in lint workflow
architecture_decisions.rationale: UV_NO_SYNC=true prevents uv from attempting to sync dependencies during CI runs, which is unnecessary since dependencies are already locked in uv.lock. This speeds up CI execution by skipping redundant dependency resolution. The --inexact flag in lint workflow allows for more flexible dependency resolution during development while maintaining locked versions for releases.
alternatives_considered: Keeping full dependency resolution in CI
Using different flags for different workflows

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Updated version from 0.3.18rc2 to 0.3.18 in pyproject.toml and removed rc suffixes from dependency version constraints
architecture_decisions.rationale: This marks the transition from release candidate to stable release. Removing rc suffixes from dependencies (langchain-core, langchain-text-splitters, langchain-anthropic, langchain-openai) ensures users get stable versions. The version bump follows semantic versioning and indicates the library is ready for production deployment.
alternatives_considered: Keeping rc versions for gradual rollout

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Updated multiple dependency versions in uv.lock including langchain-deepseek (0.0.1 → 0.1.1), langchain-google-vertexai (2.0.12 → 2.0.13), and langchain-tests (0.3.10 → 0.3.11)
architecture_decisions.rationale: These updates ensure compatibility with the new 0.3.18 release. The langchain-deepseek update includes a major refactor (changing dependency from langchain to langchain-core + langchain-openai). Other updates fix bugs or add features needed for the stable release. All updates maintain backward compatibility within major version constraints.

implementation_summary:
The changes implement a comprehensive preparation for the LangChain 0.3.18 stable release. The core approach involves transitioning from release candidate to stable versioning across the codebase, optimizing CI/CD workflows for efficiency, and updating dependency management to use uv exclusively.

Key patterns include: 1) Systematic removal of rc (release candidate) suffixes from all version references, indicating readiness for production use; 2) Elimination of Poetry configuration in favor of uv, streamlining the package management toolchain; 3) Addition of UV_NO_SYNC=true environment variable across GitHub Actions workflows to prevent redundant dependency resolution during CI runs, significantly improving build performance.

The changes integrate seamlessly with the existing codebase by maintaining backward compatibility—all version updates stay within major version constraints (e.g., langchain-core<1.0.0,>=0.3.34). The dependency updates in uv.lock reflect necessary compatibility fixes, particularly for langchain-deepseek which underwent a significant refactor. The CI optimizations demonstrate a mature understanding of build pipeline efficiency, where skipping unnecessary operations during locked dependency scenarios provides tangible performance benefits without compromising reliability.
